display_long_description:
Step into an immersive creative space where you can draw and paint music around you, turning sound into vivid visuals that fill the room. Build ideas on the spot using expressive live looping, sampling, and layering tools that let you create full tracks in real time. Shape your music with high-quality samplers, loopers, recorders, and synthesizers, or connect wirelessly to your DAW for deeper production. Join others in a shared multiplayer studio—complete with a collaborative stage—where musicians can jam, perform, and develop ideas together instantly. Whether you’re sketching rhythms or crafting full songs, this app offers a fresh, intuitive, and inspiring way to make music in mixed reality and VR.

⸻

Updated Feature List:
	•	Draw and paint music as immersive sound visuals in 3D space
	•	Powerful live looping for instant real-time creation
	•	High-quality samplers, loopers, recorders, and synthesizers
	•	Sampling, layering, and sound-design tools
	•	Wireless MIDI / DAW integration
	•	Shared multiplayer studio with a collaborative stage
	•	Works in both Mixed Reality and full VR
	•	Complete creative toolkit included with your purchase
